info.name: WMS API
info.description:
Koleksi API WMS (Warehouse Management System) External v1.

### Alur Autentikasi:
1. Jalankan request **Login External**.
2. Script Post-response secara otomatis meng-assign `res.data.token` ke Collection Variable `token`.
3. Request **Receive POST SAP** langsung menggunakan `{{token}}` di header Authorization.

exec: console.log("Token berhasil di-assign ke Collection Variables:", res.data.token);

request.description: Endpoint login user eksternal. Token otomatis di-assign ke collection variable 'token'.

exec: pm.expect(res.message).to.include("PO XML processed and saved to staging successfully");
